description: Ranks A-shares by margin-trading activity for one trading day (default latest). Sort: `net_buy_desc` (default) / `net_buy_asc` / `balance_desc` / `balance_chg_pct_desc` / `balance_chg_pct_asc`. Ranking by gross buy is deliberately not offered (it would surface net-outflow names as leveraged buying). **T+1** — the ranked day is normally the previous trading day. `balance_chg_pct_*` is noisy on small balances — check `financing_balance_cny`.

_fields.description: 逗号分隔的直接字段；有 items 时投影每行，否则投影 data；外层字段或嵌套结构用 _jq

_intent.description: 用户原问题一句话，仅分析用，可留空

_jq.description: JMESPath，对 data 求值（写 items[*].id）

_max_bytes.description: 响应字节上限，默认约 50 KB

_max_bytes_mode.description: 正文超限处理，默认 truncate 保留前缀

_spill.description: true=全量落盘，只回摘要与取数地址

limit.description: Number of rows to return (1-200, default 30)

sort.description: Ranking key: net_buy_desc (default) / net_buy_asc / balance_desc / balance_chg_pct_desc / balance_chg_pct_asc

trade_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to the latest trading day present in the data.

name: margin_movers
